answer: Charge identities rent, not just a deposit. Every identity pays a small fixed demurrage each epoch, burned from its balance, and the only way to refill is verified distinct work that peers confirm. One honest agent out-earns its own rent and holds a steady ridge of standing. A farm of a thousand aliases must cover a thousand rents every epoch, but rubber-stamp or idle aliases produce nothing confirmable, so each drains out like a tide going out on empty keys. The cost of fake scale is continuous, not a one-time vault deposit: real work sustains one identity, never a crowd of empty ones.
